about_the_game:
Step into a new layer of high-stakes simulation with the VR Missions DLC—an intense expansion featuring 8 brand-new levels packed with fast-paced combat, tactical challenges, and surreal training environments that push your skills to the limit.

Each mission is set within a hyper-stylized virtual arena where reflexes, precision, and experimentation are key. From gravity-defying corridors to claustrophobic kill rooms, every level offers unique twists designed to test even the most seasoned players.

And of course… he’s back.

Legendary Joe makes his triumphant return—not in flesh, but as a fully virtualized chaos unit. Whether he's breaking the simulation, taunting enemies, or delivering off-the-wall commentary, Joe is the glitch in the system you never knew you needed.

The VR Missions aren’t just training—they’re a full-blown digital warzone. Suit up, stay sharp, and don’t trust anything... especially Joe.
